Full picture, root cause found:

**02:14:07** — Redis at 10.0.0.12:6379 drop: `ECONNREFUSED`. API fall back to direct store reads.

**02:14:07 onward** — cache miss storm, every request now hit store direct. Store overload, TimeoutErrors (5000ms) start cascade across api/worker-1/worker-2/scheduler, repeat every ~2s.

**02:14:12 → 02:31:26** — request queue depth climb steady, 52 → 568 (max 500 breached ~02:25:48, queue 400+, worse from there). Redis reconnect attempts fail every ~140s: attempt 0 (02:15:26) through attempt 12 (02:31:26), all `ECONNREFUSED` — redis never came back, 17 min total.

**02:31:44** — worker-2 heap OOM (`JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)`) — unbounded queue growth ate memory.

**02:31:45** — supervisor restart worker-2, exit code 134.

**02:31:52** — api unresponsive, supervisor kill whole process group. Service down.

Root cause: Redis instance (10.0.0.12:6379) died at 02:14:07 and never recovered (12 failed reconnects over 17 min). Fallback path (direct store reads, no backpressure) overwhelm store, queue grow unbounded, worker OOM, cascading kill.

Fix priorities: bound request queue (max 500 ignored, kept growing past 568), circuit-break on repeated store timeouts instead of retry-storm, alert on redis down + reconnect backoff, check why 10.0.0.12 dropped.
